item.title: AWS Introduces Preview of Well-Architected Agent
item.description:
AWS recently announced the preview of the Well-Architected Agent, a service that analyzes environments against Well-Architected best practices and provides prioritized recommendations across cost, security, performance, and reliability. The AI agent can also suggest remediation steps and review infrastructure-as-code before deployment.

By Renato Losio

item.title: AWS Will Run Its European Sovereign Cloud Without the Global Backbone for Several Hours
item.description:
On October 24, AWS will operate its European Sovereign Cloud without a connection to the AWS Global Network backbone, with a team of EU residents and the region’s own hardware and software. AWS says neither of the two systems being severed is operation-critical, and practitioners are divided over whether the exercise answers the question customers are asking.

By Steef-Jan Wiggers
